headlines.title: Video game giant Electronic Arts closes $55 billion go-private sale of its business
headlines.summary: Video game giant Electronic Arts officially has new owners.  The California-based maker of popular titles like “Battlefield” and “The Sims” announced Tuesday that it closed the $55 billion sale of its business to Saudi Arabia’s sovereign wealth fund PIF, investment firm Silver Lake Partners and Affinity Partners, which is run by U.S. President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner.  In a statement, CEO Andrew Wilson said EA and its new owners would “invest boldly, accelerate innovation, and build the next generation of games and experiences for the hundreds of millions of players and fans who inspire us every day.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia's investment fund buys Electronic Arts in U.S. latest entertainment push
headlines.summary: Electronic Arts, the gaming company known for franchises such as "The Sims" and "Battlefield," has been acquired by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, Silver Lake and Affinity Partners for $55 billion.

Donald Trump’s son-in-law, Saudi Arabia PIF-led group buy Madden and FC publisher EA for $55 billion
headlines.summary: Electronic Arts have now been purchased in a massive deal worth $55 billion, with Jared Kushner’s Affinity Partners and Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund leading the consortium. Electronic Arts, or EA, develop some of the biggest game franchises in the world, especially for sports fans.

headlines.title: The Sims and EA FC maker Electronic Arts sells for $55bn to Saudi-led group
headlines.summary: The deal takes the maker of titles including The Sims and EA FC into private ownership - and loads it with debt.

description: Electronic Arts Inc. develops, markets, publishes, and delivers games, content, and services for game consoles, PCs, and mobile phones worldwide. It develops and publishes games and experiences across diverse genres, such as sports, racing, first-person shooter, action, role-playing, and simulation; and live services offerings, including extra content and subscription offerings through its global football and American football franchises, such as EA SPORTS College Football and EA SPORTS Madden NFL, as well as based on its IP comprising The Sims, Apex Legends, and Battlefield. The company markets and sells its games and services through digital distribution and retail channels; and directly to mass market retailers, specialty stores, and distribution arrangements. Electronic Arts Inc. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Redwood City, California.
